async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Reports link to expand its menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="\ue74a Reports", exact=True)
    await reports_link.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for menu to expand
    # Try to locate the Order Count link within the expanded menu
    # Use a more general locator: look for a link with name "Order Count" anywhere on the page after menu expansion
    order_count_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Order Count", exact=True)
    await order_count_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Ensure content is loaded
